delete.description: Clear a project's history of every run recorded before the run `before`.

post.description:
Runs a recorded run's code again with some input cells set, in
another precision, after training steps on its weights, or with one
step's result knocked out or patched in from another run.

The result is kept in memory for a while, outside the project's
history, so its values can be read like any run's.

Knocks out each slice of one step's result in turn, along an axis,
and reports how far the model's output moved each time. Nothing is
saved.

Every weight the run read, with its norm and singular values, and
with `against`, what changed in it since another run.

A watch expression at every step where one of the names it reads
changed, as one number per step. Nothing is saved.

Evaluates an expression over the run's named tensors at a step.

Each name reads its latest state up to that step (and the step's own
result); `params["…"]` reads the model's weights. Nothing is saved.

The gradient's size at every recorded tensor, for one value of a run.

Runs the recorded code again with gradients on; nothing is saved.

How much one result cell moves per unit change of each input cell.

Runs the recorded code again with gradients on; nothing is saved.

get.description: Where the values pass a comparison, or fall in a histogram bar.
The first smallest and largest finite values, and the non-finite ones.
Row and column reductions of the plane through `fixed`.
Totals over a selected rectangle of the plane through `fixed`.
Statistics of each index along one axis, e.g. per channel.
A small picture of the plane at each index of a hidden axis.
Whether every sum over an axis is `value`, for a sums contract.
The recorded values as a .npy file, for numpy.load or torch.from_numpy.

post.description: Per-tensor change summaries against an earlier run, null where unknown.

Evaluation.title: Evaluation
Evaluation.description:
A watch expression's value: a tensor summarized, any other value as
text, or the error it raised.

GradientFlow.title: GradientFlow
GradientFlow.description:
The size (L2 norm) of ∂ target / ∂ each recorded tensor it depends on.

Tensors the target does not depend on, such as those computed after it,
are left out; a tensor that is used but whose gradient vanishes reads 0.

GradientRequest.title: GradientRequest
GradientRequest.description: A value to differentiate: one cell of a result, or (no index) its sum.

Histogram.title: Histogram
Histogram.description: How a tensor's finite values are spread, in equal-width bins.

InputEdit.title: InputEdit
InputEdit.description: One cell of a generated input set to another value: a what-if.

Knockout.title: Knockout
Knockout.description:
One step's result replaced as the run makes it, before anything reads it.

`zero` sets it to zero, `mean` to its mean, and `patch` to the same
step's result in another run. With `axis` and `index`, only that slice
changes (one head, one word), and `mean` is the mean over the axis: the
average slice.

KnockoutSweep.title: KnockoutSweep
KnockoutSweep.description: Every slice of one step's result knocked out in turn, along one axis.

LatestRun.title: LatestRun
LatestRun.description: A project's newest run, for marking projects in lists.

LearnStep.title: LearnStep
LearnStep.description:
One step of gradient descent on every weight, on one recorded value.

`direction` 1 raises the value, -1 lowers it: each weight moves by
rate · direction · ∂ value / ∂ weight before the run is recorded again.

LoopStep.title: LoopStep
LoopStep.description: One enclosing loop of an operation and the iteration it ran in.

ReadProject.title: ReadProject
ReadProject.description: A ready-to-run draft and anything the reader could not use.

Sensitivity.title: Sensitivity
Sensitivity.description:
How much a result cell moves per unit change of each input cell.

`gradient`: ∂ result / ∂ input, one value per input cell. `embedding`: for
integer inputs (token ids), the size (L2 norm) of the gradient at the
embedding each id was looked up as, one value per token.

SensitivityRequest.title: SensitivityRequest
SensitivityRequest.description: A result cell whose dependence on the input is wanted.

SweepResult.title: SweepResult
SweepResult.description:
How far the model's output moved with each slice knocked out.

`effects[i]` is ‖y − y₀‖ / ‖y₀‖ of the first output with slice i
knocked out. `cell` is the output's largest value in the recorded run,
and `cell_values[i]` what it became.

WatchRequest.title: WatchRequest
WatchRequest.description: A Python expression over a run's named tensors, as they were at a step.

WatchSeries.title: WatchSeries
WatchSeries.description:
A watch expression at every step where one of its names changed: the
expression must give one number.

WeightSpectrum.title: WeightSpectrum
WeightSpectrum.description:
A weight of the model: its size, its norm, and as a matrix
([first axis, everything else]) its singular values.

WeightUpdate.title: WeightUpdate
WeightUpdate.description: How a weight changed since another run: W − W₀, with its spectrum.
